Instruction TTS.requirement: No audio required. Enter the words to speak and a voice description.
Instruction TTS.example: Target text: Welcome back. | Voice description: A warm, clear young female voice.
Instruction TTS.note: Generates a voice from a description. Choose Voice cloning to match a recorded speaker.

Voice cloning.requirement: Connect clear reference speech from one speaker. Enter only the new words to speak.
Voice cloning.example: Target text: Hello, and welcome to today's program.
Voice cloning.note: Leave the reference transcript and voice description blank; AuK uses its official fixed cloning prompt.

Speech text editing.primary_label: Edit request (one change at a time)
Speech text editing.secondary_label: Full source transcript (optional, duration estimate only)
Speech text editing.requirement: Connect ordinary spoken audio. Make one replacement, insertion, or deletion, using the exact original words.
Speech text editing.note: Also: Insert 'everyone' after 'Hello'; Delete 'um'. The optional full transcript is used only for duration estimation.

Lyric editing.primary_label: Lyric replacement (one change at a time)
Lyric editing.secondary_label: Full source lyrics (optional, duration estimate only)
Lyric editing.requirement: Connect clean, isolated solo singing without accompaniment (a cappella). Replace one phrase matching the actual lyrics.
Lyric editing.example: Change 'hello tomorrow' to 'hello future' in the vocal recording.
Lyric editing.note: Use Speech text editing for spoken audio. The optional full lyrics are used only for duration estimation.

Pitch editing.requirement: Connect audio. Supported changes are +/-1, +/-2, or +/-3 semitones.
Pitch editing.note: Zero and other values are outside the model's supported settings.

Speed editing.note: 1.0 makes no change. Duration is effective speech duration divided by the multiplier; manual duration and Float are ignored.

Volume editing.requirement: Connect audio. Supported changes are +/-5, +/-10, or +/-15 dB.

Emotion editing.requirement: Connect spoken audio. Choose happy, angry, sad, fearful, surprised, disgusted, calm, or excited.
Emotion editing.note: Preserves words and voice identity. Match the request language to the source speech; Chinese requests remain supported.

Timbre editing.requirement: Connect spoken audio and describe the desired voice.
Timbre editing.example: A deep, resonant young male voice
Timbre editing.note: Changes voice character while preserving the words. Choose a speech generation task to speak new text.

Accent removal.requirement: Connect spoken audio with a regional or dialect accent.
Accent removal.note: Preserves the speaker's voice and words. The official prompt targets regional accent removal.

Nonverbal sound editing.requirement: Connect audio. Add or remove one event, such as laughter, breathing, a sigh, or a cough.
Nonverbal sound editing.note: Also: Remove all breathing; Add a sigh at the beginning. Unknown events or missing positions are rejected.

Whisper conversion.requirement: Connect spoken audio. Specify whisper conversion or a return to normal speech.
Whisper conversion.note: Preserves the words and voice identity.

Speech enhancement.requirement: Connect spoken audio to remove background noise and/or room reverberation.
Speech enhancement.note: Keeps all speakers. Use Speaker separation to keep only one speaker.

Audio quality repair.requirement: Connect spoken audio to restore high frequencies/bandwidth or repair telephone, megaphone, or underwater coloration.
Audio quality repair.example: Restore high frequencies and clarity; or: Remove the telephone effect
Audio quality repair.note: Use Speech enhancement for ordinary background noise and room reverberation.

Speaker separation.requirement: Connect audio with multiple speakers. Select a speaker by the order in which they start speaking.
Speaker separation.note: Keeps the selected speaker. Additional requirements may include denoise, dereverb, or both.

Music vocal extraction.requirement: Connect mixed audio with accompaniment and specify the vocals to retain.
Music vocal extraction.note: Use 'Keep all vocals' to retain both speech and singing while removing accompaniment.

Target speaker extraction.requirement: Connect audio with multiple speakers. Enter a short, exact phrase spoken by the target speaker.
Target speaker extraction.note: Uses those words to identify the speaker. Additional requirements may include denoise, dereverb, or both.
